## Why this name

- Retail body is exactly 'movs r2, #0 / swi #5 / bx lr'; BIOS SWI 0x05 is VBlankIntrWait
- All 38 call sites call it with no arguments, and the header has always had to keep it unprototyped so that would compile
- Every call site is the same frame sequence: sub_08061BE8 (queue VRAM upload) -> update -> sub_080674B4() -> _08073C40 commit, i.e. wait for VBlank before presenting
- Corrected the definition's signature from the misleading (const void *src, void *dest) to (void)
